notes: Fixes a thread race in the DC caster, a duplicated cast tracker, spell-library saves colliding between clients, and per-monster data that grew forever. The spell catalog lookup is cached instead of repeated every tick. Also restart-safe: the Plugin Hub can now restart it every 10 minutes (change or turn off on the hub's Diagnostics page) so long sessions stay smooth, and settings and progress carry over. Settings files are now saved safely, so a crash can no longer reset them.
